verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is itself an AI agent that works over the user's own project. Its Explore mode answers read-only questions about the codebase, and its tools search project files and return LSP diagnostics, so users get AI-generated answers and feedback about their code inside the product. There is no documented insights or suggestions feature aimed at user data more broadly. Missing for 10: an explicit insights/suggestions capability over user data, analysis of non-code data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Switch to Explore mode for read-only codebase questions with minimal latency.
Mastra Code can search project files and attach a path to your message when you type `@` followed by part of a filename
Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
